caption: Is it just my 19 mo toddler or do all toddlers become picky eaters at this age?! 🤣 Anyways, wanted to try this fun Korean style rice cake recipe for Zen’s Christmas eve treat. It’s so easy and involves no added sugar, so try it during this holiday season for your baby. 🙂 You need: 1-2 tangerines (I used 1 and a half), 1/4 cup of rice flour and 1 egg 1. Peel off the thin, transparent membrane of the tangerine then cut or mash the pulp  2. Add 1/4 cup of flour & an egg, and mix! 3. Microwave for 3 min in a microwave safe bowl (tip: use paper baking sheet to cover the bottom of the bowl for easy removal like I did in the video)  Recipe from: @luna__yyu ♥️🫶🏼 . . . #blw#babyledweaning#blwrecipe#babyledweaningideas #blwinspiration #babyfood #toddlermeals #toddlersnacks #babysnacks  Baby led weaning ideas BLW recipe Dessert for baby Baby snacks
